name: Fungal Spores
summary: At the Barrens oases, Horde adventurers gather Fungal Spores for Apothecary Helbrim of the Royal Apothecary Society. Strange, mutative energies flow through the springs and alter the local plants into potent reagents. Helbrim seeks the specimens to brew concoctions for his colleague in Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: Vibrant and Mutated Flora
sections.body: The Barrens is a dry savanna, but the Forgotten Pools, Lushwater Oasis, and Stagnant Oasis brim with unnatural vitality. A curious surge of life energy flows from their waters, warping and invigorating plants and beasts that drink there. Laden mushrooms grow along the muddy banks, absorbing those currents. Their spores hold rare properties that draw the curiosity of passing alchemists.

sections.title: The Royal Apothecary Society in Kalimdor
sections.body: Apothecary Helbrim works at the Crossroads, far from the Undercity, yet remains devoted to the Royal Apothecary Society's research. He gathers the altered spores because Kalimdor's native reagents have strange potency, and he uses them to craft powerful mixtures. The specimens are destined for Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff, part of the Forsaken's scientific work across allied lands.

faq.q: Where do these fungal spores grow?
faq.answer: Laden mushrooms grow along the water's edge at Barrens oases, including the Forgotten Pools, the Lushwater Oasis, and the Stagnant Oasis.

faq.q: Why are the mushrooms altered near the oases?
aliases: what is wrong with the oases
faq.answer: A powerful surge of life energy flows through the Barrens oasis waters. It vigorously alters nearby wildlife and flora instead of merely sustaining ordinary plant growth.

Apothecary Helbrim is a Forsaken member of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He studies the region's unusual biology and gathers local materials for alchemical study.

faq.q: What does Helbrim plan to do with the spores?
faq.answer: Helbrim uses the potent spores to brew a specific concoction for his research associate, Apothecary Zamah, in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why are Forsaken apothecaries operating in the Barrens?
faq.answer: As Horde allies, Forsaken researchers study Kalimdor's foreign environments and unusual flora, seeking new reagents for medicines, toxins, and concoctions.

faq.q: Which oasis is safest to collect the spores from?
faq.answer: The Forgotten Pools, northwest of the Crossroads, has lower-level wildlife than the Lushwater Oasis or the Stagnant Oasis to the south, making it the safest place to gather mushrooms.

angles.text: Far from Lordaeron, Forsaken researchers continue their alchemical work, turning Kalimdor's natural anomalies toward the goals of the Royal Apothecary Society.
Investigating the disturbed waters of the Barrens helps protect the vital trails connecting Orgrimmar, the Crossroads, and Thunder Bluff.
The oases hold an unnaturally turbulent surge of nature magic that causes aggressive mutations in the surrounding ecosystem.
Laden mushrooms around the Barrens oases show how sudden infusions of environmental energy can transform ordinary plants into potent reagents.
